rules: 1 all-in crypto pick per day, 100% deployed
Spot crypto only (BTC, ETH, SOL, and other liquid coins on Robinhood)
Rotate each 6:45am CT run — sell yesterday, buy today's best
Hard stop at entry; leverage conviction, protect downside

positions.name: Ethereum
positions.catalyst: ETH is the relative-strength major into today's mixed, pulling-back tape. It opened Monday ~+2.2% off Sunday's open (~1,883) — outperforming a red BTC (~62,643, pressured by the fourth-wave Coldcard hardware-wallet breach that drained ~389 BTC) and a red SOL (~72.59, -1.28%). Global crypto cap +1.2% / 24h to ~$2.25T on ~$38B volume. ETH pairs the session's best momentum among the majors with major-grade liquidity and downside protection on a headwind-heavy day (security breach + no follow-through from U.S.-Iran de-escalation). Canonical price 1861.89 (dashboard Yahoo feed; corroborated by narrative sources putting ETH ~1,840-1,883 today).
positions.driver: Closed prior SOL at 73.14 (canonical dashboard feed) vs entry 73.01 for +18.48 — SOL flat-to-down as its ETF-inflow catalyst stopped translating into price (still ~57% below ETF-launch levels). Rotated INTO ETH as best risk-adjusted next-24h pick on a lower-edge, risk-wobbly session: strategy favors majors on low-edge days, and ETH shows the cleanest relative strength (opened +2.2%, leading red BTC and SOL) with better downside protection than higher-beta SOL. Wins vs runners-up: SOL flow catalyst intact (positive July ETF inflows daily, MoneyGram validator, Solana Pay Korea pilot) but momentum cooled; BTC safest major but carries a DIRECT negative catalyst today (Coldcard ~389 BTC breach). Dashboard price of record used to avoid phantom P&L; external exchange APIs (Coinbase/Kraken) quoted an inconsistent basis and were NOT used. 8% major stop keeps payoff asymmetric.
positions.risks: Relative-strength signal is fragile — ETH faded from its ~1,883 open toward ~1,840 intraday. A broad risk-off flush from the security-breach overhang or renewed geopolitical stress would drag ETH with the tape. No fresh idiosyncratic bullish catalyst today; defensive relative-strength hold, not a breakout. Hard stop 1712.94 (-8%).
